user_query: I'm organizing a team-building activity for my company and I want to include a translation challenge. Can you search translations for the phrase 'Teamwork makes the dream work' in different languages using the MyMemory - Translation Memory API? It would also be helpful to fetch the last fresh result from the Love Calculator API to create some fun interactions among the team members.
